pitfalls.expectation: Reject undeclared trailing-only additions; knowledge must be filed into the existing structure.
Reject a removed, renamed, reused, or silently replaced paragraph identifier without a valid authored redirect.
Require memory-only and scratch-only claims to remain reported until a ratified source is attached.
Reject a paragraph link that resolves to neither a live anchor nor a permanent redirect.
Reject a patch when regenerated navigation or anchor indexes differ from the committed bytes.
Reject a verification-date-only edit that adds no evidence for the re-check.
Reject secret values, personal contact details, and live infrastructure topology without reproducing matched content in diagnostics.
Reject every paragraph or chapter pin whose source cannot be resolved in the reviewed repository snapshot or authored external-source lock.
